# News Jace Pro

> An independent ServiceNow news aggregator and ecosystem directory.

External articles belong to their original publishers. Follow source links for original reporting.

## Public directories

- [ServiceNow news and ecosystem search](https://news.jace.pro/): Search collected ServiceNow news, partners, applications, financial activity, events, sessions, and MVP awards.
- [ServiceNow news](https://news.jace.pro/i): Browse ServiceNow articles, videos, and podcasts collected from external sources. Follow the source links to read the originals.
- [ServiceNow partners](https://news.jace.pro/p): Browse the ServiceNow partner directory and filter companies by services, partner level, and location.
- [ServiceNow Store applications](https://news.jace.pro/a): Browse the collected ServiceNow Store application directory by company, application type, and availability.
- [ServiceNow financial activity](https://news.jace.pro/financials): Explore ServiceNow acquisitions, investments, and company filings collected from public sources.
- [ServiceNow events and sessions](https://news.jace.pro/e): Browse Knowledge and other event session collections, speakers, and available recordings.
- [ServiceNow MVP awards](https://news.jace.pro/mvps): Explore ServiceNow community MVP award recipients and awards by year and type.

Sitemap: https://news.jace.pro/sitemap.xml
